== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Y-wing Assault Squadron (Japanese)|Y-wing Assault Squadron]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Japanese A New Hope PSA showcase], PSA certificate 157709607.

Crop rectangle <code>(130, 595, 1305, 2238)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>85b5702532e419e2658ecbeaa13c8eda9dd2912f6a7b44584276468a8d34932b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
